review:
Chicken Rush is a western slot with a classic 243-ways base game, wilds with multipliers, and a very unusual bonus.

Three or more bonus symbols trigger free spins. At the start, the game picks one sticky symbol for the round and turns every position into a wooden box. Each spin opens some boxes, revealing the chosen symbol, a multiplier or +1 free spin, without paying out immediately. Your final win depends on how many sticky symbols you've uncovered by the end, and collecting five multipliers boosts the result further. There are three bonus buy options where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 123 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
